items.name: Affliction Bolt
items.description: Summons a semi-intelligent necroplasm for ~lifetime~ seconds which will inflict a curse upon each enemy it touches. Cursed enemies will take ~AfflictionCurse.damage~ energy damage over ~AfflictionCurse.duration~ seconds.

items.name: Arboreal Might
items.description: Enrages Arborus, increasing all damage by ~damageBoost~%. The enrage lasts ~duration~ seconds and stacks up to ~maxStackCount~ times. When an enemy dies within ~nearbyDeathDistance~m, the duration is refreshed.

items.name: Enrage
items.description: Sends the targeted ally into a rage, increasing the damage of non-periodic attacks by ~Enrage.damage~ for ~Enrage.duration~ seconds and regenerating ~Enrage.healing~ health over that period.

items.name: Entangling Rush
items.description: Charges at a single target, dealing ~minDamage~-~maxDamage~ physical damage to that enemy. Thick roots will grow around the target, entangling all enemies within ~radius~m for ~duration~ seconds.

items.name: Force Pulse
items.description: Launches a projectile that deals ~minDamage~-~maxDamage~ energy damage and knocks back the target. Individual enemies can only be knocked back once every ~duration~ seconds.

items.name: Ghostform
items.description: Becomes incorporeal for ~duration~ seconds, causing projectiles to pass through Wraith and granting a ~dodgePercent~% chance to dodge physical attacks.

items.name: Grasping Dead
items.description: Enemies within ~auraRange~m have their movement speed reduced by ~percent~%.

items.name: Gravity Storm
items.description: Raises enemies in a targeted ~radius~m radius area into the air, immobilizing them with the force of gravity. After ~GravityStormModifier.duration~ seconds they are slammed into the ground, dealing ~GravityStormModifier.minDamage~-~GravityStormModifier.maxDamage~ physical damage to each enemy.

items.name: Phantom Charge
items.description: Charges through enemies, causing ~minDamage~-~maxDamage~ energy damage and suppressing them for ~silenceDuration~ seconds.

items.name: Rampant Growth
items.description: Allies within ~auraRange~m have their periodic damage and periodic healing increased by ~percent~%.

items.name: Sleeping Cloud
items.description: Releases a continuous stream of relaxation spores for ~channelDuration~ seconds that cause enemies within ~radius~m to fall asleep.

items.name: Soul Link
items.description: Damage taken by ~CHAR_NAME~ is shared among the rest of the squad for ~duration~ seconds. Healing is also shared but only after ~CHAR_NAME~ is at full health.  While Soul Link is active, ~CHAR_NAME~ will gain the passive abilities of the other squad members.

items.name: Splintering Cleave
items.description: A sweeping attack that deals ~minDamage~-~maxDamage~ physical damage to both the target and another nearby enemy. If Arborus swings four times in succession, the final hit will instead deal ~lastHitMinDamage~-~lastHitMaxDamage~ physical damage to a single target.

items.name: Sporogenesis
items.description: Emits cleansing spores that remove all debuffs from allies within ~radius~m. Affected allies will gain a heal over time effect that restores ~SporogenesisHot.healing~ health over ~SporogenesisHot.duration~ seconds.

items.name: Tree of Life
items.description: Places a tree that heals allies within 8m for 3 health per second. After 6 seconds, the tree will explode in a burst of energy and return an additional 12-18 health to nearby allies.
